title: A Computational Analysis of the Dehumanisation of Migrants from Syria and Ukraine in Slovene News Media

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the dehumanization of migrants in news media by computing Word2Vec cosine similarities between migrant-related terms and concept vectors for 'moral disgust' and 'vermin', and performing paragraph-level sentiment analysis (valence and arousal).

Comparing semantic similarity and sentiment analysis scores across news corpora from the 2015-16 Syrian migration crisis and the 2022-23 Ukrainian migration crisis, as well as comparing sub-corpora that explicitly mention Ukrainian migrants versus non-Ukrainian migrants.
